translation: (In the hollow below the lip.) It encircles the lip, ascends to the lower gum junction, then again emerges and divides, runs along the face, connects to the center below both eyes, and ends at Chengqi (ST1). (Seven fen below the eye, directly below the pupil in the hollow, two points.) Twenty-seven points in all. The Nanjing and the Jiayi Jing both do not have the statement of running along the face and below.
